content.text: Luka Doncic and the Los Angeles Lakers carry their six-game winning streak on the road against the Orlando Magic. The Los Angeles Lakers (45-25) are rolling, winners of six straight, to climb up to third in the Western Conference. Three of those wins have come on the road, where Luka Doncic has scored 136 points. Los Angeles carries that winning streak on the road against the Orlando Magic (38-31) for the second and final time this season. Orlando was playing its best basketball of the season, winning seven straight, but has lost three straight. In the first game between the teams, Orlando won 110-109. Paolo Banchero went off for 36 points, 10 rebounds, and six assists in the win on 12-22 shooting.
